blocker.message: os_inv plus linklist_suspend_admissible supplies current-task registration and scheduling conditions, but does not imply the required assignRunningTask(os_assign held) <> 0. Task invariants intentionally omit base nonzero, assign_world_wf permits running=0, and QCP valid_object permits address zero. The carried universal future-delay condition also supplies no nonzero premise.
